messages:
deploybot: ALERT: canary-usw2 embeddings pipeline: p95 latency +18% vs baseline and small quality drift detected. error-rate 0.6% > threshold. Auto-revert suppressed (flag: dedicated-pinned). Suggested action: surgical rollback of hosted variant 'emb-2.1-fp16' -> 'emb-2.0-fp16'. Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood/ret/1749012345 :warning:

maya: @deploybot thanks — any correlation with yesterday's quant-kernel-2 rollout? :eyes:

samir: timeline matches. quant-kernel-2 flip at 09:10 in canary. I can see increased KV cache misses in the logs (kv_miss spikes).

leah: ran a quick local eval on eng-eval-1000: avg cosine dropped 0.92 -> 0.88 for emb-2.1 on subset. Quality regression looks real.

eric: note that dedicated customers are still pinned to emb-2.0, so exposure is limited, but hosted canary saw the hit. We should avoid a global revert if possible.

maya: proposal: surgical rollback for hosted canary only. Do a staged traffic split: 10% -> emb-2.0, hold 5m, validate, then 50%, then 100%. No change to dedicated pools.

samir: +1. Command I'll run: 
```
/rollout traffic-split embeddings canary-usw2 --from emb-2.1 --to emb-2.0 --percent 10
```

ops-bot: runbook reminder: tag incident if customer-visible degradation > 5m; escalate to oncall if rollback lasts > 4h. Attach CI eval results to this thread. :memo:

leah: I will own validation. Re-running eng-eval-1000 after split and monitoring p95 + cosine and recall.

eric: I'll draft a 1-paragraph customer note for enterprise channels and support playbook: say we applied a mitigation and no action required.

maya: Samir, proceed and ping sales/CS once the 10% split is initiated. :thumbsup:

samir: Kicking off split now, will paste job logs.

samir: log: traffic-split job started (job id 54f2). Rolling 10% to emb-2.0. ETA ~ 90s.

samir: log: split steady. Initial validation (sample prompts): cosine = 0.91 (improved vs 0.88). Monitoring window 5m.

leah: after 3m: recall and cosine trending back to baseline, latency steady. Recommend bump to 50% after full 5m.

maya: bump to 50% then wait 5m.

samir: executing -> 50%. job id 54f3.

ops-bot: throttling/alerts suppressed for migration window.

samir: monitoring shows stability at 50%, no error-rate uptick. Pushing to 100% now.

samir: complete. hosted canary-usw2 rolled back to emb-2.0-fp16. No rollout errors.

eric: sent short note to sales/support with link to thread + bullet points.

maya: filing release-note entry: 'embeddings: temporary rollback of emb-2.1 in hosted canary due to regression observed with quant-kernel-2; investigating. Dedicated pools unaffected.'

leah: opening ticket to reproduce regression in CI and add an eval guard around quant-kernel-2 changes.

maya: thanks all — leave pinned until CI reproduces, then we can decide safe re-roll. Closing thread when release-note and ticket are created. :white_check_mark:
